beats.label: Gut x aging
beats.text: Your **gut** may hint how fast you **age.**

beats.label: The study
beats.text: **123** adults gave stool and blood samples. Scientists matched gut bacteria to **aging** **clocks.**

beats.label: Thing 1
beats.text: Gut bacteria explained about **15%** of the differences in aging **pace.**

beats.label: Thing 3
beats.text: Another microbe, **Succinivibrio,** was linked to **faster** aging.

beats.label: Why it matters
beats.text: Unlike your birthday, your gut **responds** to diet, activity and **stress.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: A **link,** not proof. It's still **unknown** whether changing your gut slows **aging.**
